scope: Accept S1-LL19-a at its reviewed bounded generated control/recovery scope; preserve declared exclusions and carry audit observations into integration/follow-up.
exclusions: Debugger depth occupies schema scratch1 and reserve-in-use occupies scratch0; give these persistent runtime states explicit schema names without changing offsets.
One reserve flag suppresses soft checks on all three stacks while recovery runs; this differs from native per-stack guards and must remain explicit.
Add an executed ordinary-service declined-hook fatal case before the debugger boundary is relied upon.

The owner supplies this sealed bootstrap registry and wrapper identities. General CLOS metaclass construction, class redefinition and generic accessors remain LL11; symbol/package installation remains LL09. This is not a complete MAKE-CONDITION or TYPEP implementation.

Generated RESTART-CASE, RESTART-BIND, FIND-RESTART, INVOKE-RESTART and RESTART-NAME with active identity, nearest/first matching restart, dynamic retirement and full values. U1-shaped restart istructs. Anonymous names, report/test/interactive options and condition association are explicit source refusals; general restart enumeration is outside this subset.

Ordinary error-service mode invokes a generated *DEBUGGER-HOOK* with itself dynamically masked, rooted condition and restored depth; hook transfers can invoke restarts. No interactive UI debugger is supplied. Bootstrap or declined errors end in structured checked Wasm diagnostics, not engine traps.

Condition/restart slots, binding records, indirect result descriptors, stack callables and pending exceptions keep their stated root obligations. Moving-collector validation/reloads remain LL06/LL18; no collection during indivisible construction/store windows is claimed.

Single Worker, owner-authenticated lazy catalog and owner-issued symbols/metadata. The inherited symbols import namespace also carries immutable condition registry and expected-type objects. Multi-Worker publication and host re-entry across a pending exception remain later loader/runtime work.
